When the Computer boots up, the Computer shall read the Channel ID from HW.
When the Computer starts, if the other Computer has not already assumed the role of Active computer, the Computer shall assume the role of Active Computer.
If both the Computers simultaneously boot up, the Computer with Channel ID 1 shall assume the role of Active Computer.
The Active Computer shall configure itself as the Bus Master.
When the Active Computer configures itself as the Bus Master, it shall enter operational state.
The Active Computer shall detect the booting of the Standby Computer.
When the Active Computer detects the booting of the Standby Computer, the Active Computer shall send its state information to the Standby Computer.
When the Standby Computer receives state information from the Active Computer, the Standby Computer shall enter the operational state.
While in the operational state, the Computers shall repeat the execution every 10 msec.
While in the operational state, the Active Computer shall send the command to a Remote Terminal on bus A.
While in the operational state, the Active Computer shall include a heartbeat counter in its command.
While in the operational state, if any Remote Terminal does not acknowledge the commands on either bus A or B for 3 consecutive periods, the Active Computer shall declare communication failure for that Remote Terminal.
While in the operational state, if any Remote Terminal's heartbeat count does not change for 3 consecutive frames, the Active Computer shall declare failure for that Remote Terminal.
While in the operational state, if a Remote Terminal responds for 3 consecutive periods, the Active Computer shall set communication failure OFF for that Remote Terminal.
While in the operational state, if both redundant pairs of Remote Terminals are healthy, the Active Computer shall consider the average of the inputs from them.
While in the operational state, if a Remote Terminal has indicated failure in its status, the Active Computer shall not consider the inputs from it.
While in the operational state, if the inputs are not considered from a Remote Terminal, the Active Computer shall consider the inputs from the corresponding redundant pair.
While in the operational state, if the inputs from both the redundant pair of Remote Terminals are failed, the Active Computer shall retain the previous inputs.
While in the operational state, the Standby Computer shall update the status of each Remote Terminal.
While in the operational state, if the Active Computer does not send commands for 10 consecutive frames to any Remote Terminal, the Standby Computer shall take over as Active Computer.
While in the operational state, the Standby Computer shall report its health status to Active Computer.
The Computer shall send the Remote Terminal's health and status to Telemetry every 10 msec.
The Active Computer shall send the health and status of the Standby Computer to Telemetry every 10 msec.
If the Active Computer fails, the Standby Computer shall take over as Active Computer.
If the Active Computer fails, the Standby Computer shall assume the role of Active Computer.
When powered on, the Ventilator shall check for the presence of the calibration data.
When powered on, if the calibration data is not present, the Ventilator shall prompt for Calibration.
When powered on, if the calibration data is older than six months, the Ventilator shall prompt for Calibration.
If valid Calibration data is not found, the Ventilator shall not allow starting of the ventilation.
When the Start ventilation button is pressed, the Ventilator shall read configuration data from the UI Controller.
When the configuration data is read, the Ventilator shall compute the inhalation period and exhalation period from the I-E ratio and Respiration rate.
When the Start ventilation button is pressed, the Ventilator shall enter inhalation cycles.
When entering the inhalation cycle, the Ventilator shall compute the flow rate from configured Tidal volume and inhalation period.
While in the inhalation cycle, if the volume mode is chosen, the Ventilator shall maintain a constant flow rate.
While in the inhalation cycle, if the inhalation period is complete, the Ventilator shall enter the exhalation cycle.
When exiting the inhalation cycle, the Ventilator shall update the inhaled Tidal volume on the screen.
While in the exhalation cycle, the Ventilator shall maintain the lung pressure to the configured PEEP level.
While in the exhalation cycle, the Ventilator shall measure the exhaled Tidal volume.
While in the exhalation cycle, if the exhalation period is complete, the Ventilator shall enter the inhalation cycle.
When exiting the exhalation cycle, the Ventilator shall update the exhaled Tidal volume on the screen.
When exiting the exhalation cycle, the Ventilator shall read the configuration data from UI Controller.
If the lung pressure exceeds configured safety limit, the Ventilator shall open the safety valve.
If the lung pressure exceeds configured safety limit continuously for one second, the Ventilator shall open the safety valve.
If the moving average of 3 readings of lung pressure exceeds the configured safety limit, the Ventilator shall open the safety valve.
If the power source is the battery the Ventilator shall make a short beep every 3 seconds.
If the inlet air pressure is below the critical limit, the Ventilator shall make a long beep every 1 second.
If the lung pressure during the exhalation period is below PEEP for 3 consecutive breaths, the Ventilator shall make a long beep once.
If the inhaled Tidal volume and exhaled Tidal volume differ by more than 20%, the Ventilator shall show an alert on the screen.
While in the ventilation state, the Ventilator shall store the important parameters of the patient in permanent storage.
While the UAV is in the waypoint navigation mode, the UAV shall follow the path per the flight plan.
While the UAV is in the waypoint navigation mode, the UAV shall initiate the turn towards the next waypoint when the UAV is closer than 100 meters from the next waypoint.
While the UAV is in the waypoint navigation mode, the UAV shall ensure the reference speed is higher than the stall speed.
While in the takeoff stage, the UAV shall set the engine throttle to 100%.
While in the takeoff stage, when the ground speed is more than V1 m/s the UAV shall set the pitch reference to 5 degrees.
While in the takeoff stage, if a critical failure is detected, if the ground speed is less than V1 m/s, the UAV shall abort the takeoff.
While in the takeoff stage, the UAV shall ensure the track error is within 5 meters from the runway centerline.
While in the takeoff stage, if the track error is more than 5 meters from the runway centerline, if the ground speed is less than V1 m/s, the UAV shall abort takeoff.
While in the takeoff stage, if two or more WOW switches read zero consecutively for 1 second, the UAV shall declare in-air and enter the climbing state.
While in the climbing state, the UAV shall maintain the heading until the altitude is more than 500 meters from the ground.
While in the climbing state, when the UAV is aligned in the heading of the first waypoint within 1 degree, the UAV shall enter waypoint navigation mode.
While the UAV is in the waypoint navigation mode, the UAV shall ensure the difference between actual airspeed and reference airspeed is less than 5 m/s.
While the UAV is in the waypoint navigation mode, the UAV shall ensure the difference between actual altitude and reference altitude is less than 100 meters.
While the UAV is in the waypoint navigation mode, the UAV shall ensure the heading error is less than 1 degree unless collision alarms are present.
The UAV shall send position commands to control surfaces every 25 msecs.
If the difference between the commanded position and the read position is more than 3 degrees continuously for 1 second, the UAV shall declare that the control surface failed.
If any control surface has failed, the UAV shall send an alert message to the pilot.
If the rail voltage is below 26 volts continuously for 3 seconds, the UAV shall turn off the payloads.
If the engine RPM is 20% below the demanded RPM, continuously for 3 seconds, the UAV shall declare engine failure.
If the ground communication is lost continuously for more than 5 seconds, the UAV shall follow the predefined path to return home.
If the next waypoint is the last waypoint, the UAV shall enter landing phase.
While in the landing phase, the UAV shall align to the runway heading and follow the predefined path.
While in the landing phase, the UAV shall declare alignment complete if it is within a 5% error from the predefined path.
While in the landing phase, when the UAV is within 1 kilometer radius from the touch down point, if the UAV is unable to achieve alignment complete, the UAV shall abort the landing and follow the retry path.
While in the landing phase, when the alignment complete is declared, if the lateral error from the predefined path is more than 5%, the UAV shall abort the landing and follow the retry path.
While in the landing phase, when the alignment complete is declared, if the longitudinal error from the predefined path is more than 5%, the UAV shall abort the landing and follow the retry path.
While in the landing phase, if two or more WOW switches read one consecutively for 1 second, the UAV shall declare on-ground.
While in the landing phase, if on-ground is declared, the UAV shall set the engine throttle to zero.
While in the landing phase, if on-ground is declared, the UAV shall apply air brakes.
While in the landing phase, if on-ground is declared, when the ground speed is below 50 m/s, the UAV shall apply wheel brakes.
While in the landing phase, if on-ground is declared, the UAV shall ensure the track error is within 5 meters from the runway centerline.

When the timer is paused, if the door is closed, the Microwave oven shall not turn on the emission until the start button is pressed again.

While the doors are open, the elevator shall prevent the cabin movement in vertical direction.
While the doors are open, the elevator shall sense the obstacles before closing the doors.
While the doors are open, if the obstacles are not detected for more than 2 seconds, the elevator shall start closing the doors.
While closing the doors, if the obstacles are sensed, the elevator shall retract the doors open.
While doors are closed, if the cabin weight is more than 1000 kg, the elevator shall declare Overload.
If the overload is declared, the elevator shall display OL on internal and all external displays.
When the doors are closed, the elevator shall enter the ready to move state.
While in ready to move state, if internal requests do not exist, if an external request exists, the elevator shall move in the direction as per the external request.
While in moving, the elevator shall ignore the request to open the door.
While in moving, if there is either an internal or external request at the next floor, the elevator shall slow down and stop at the floor.
